# Endless Pools

> > Endless Pools manufactures innovative modular swim spas and resistance pools powered by Hydrodrive technology for fitness, therapy, swimming, and family recreation.

Endless Pools is a leader in aquatic innovation, offering compact, modular pool solutions for residential and commercial applications. The company's proprietary Hydrodrive current system enables lap swimming and aquatic exercise in small spaces, with products ranging from the EP-Series modular pools to commercial-grade swim spas.
